answer: The price of cheating is written down before any cheat arrives, so no one can plead surprise. Farrier shoeing record with farriers attestation is where the price is written: seven-year record, 4,000 horses shod, nail accounts, quarterly inspection. Cheat with a counterfeit ocean and the price is exacted at once, twice the value of the goods plus the orchard as a fine, while the ferrous is recorded in the book and read when the year turns.
